caption:
Hope after hardship: three questions from your Lord

In this surah Allah asks the Prophet ﷺ three questions: did He not find you an orphan and take care of you, find you unguided and guide you, find you in need and enrich you? Looking back at past care is a reason for hope today.

Surah Ad-Dhuhaa 93:6-8

Think of one hard time Allah brought you through, and thank Him this morning.

#hope #surahduha #sundayreminder #allahsmercy

Recitation: Mohamed Siddiq Al-Minshawi
